chapters.title: Sorted window with bisect

frames.caption: Sorted window with bisect — O(n k) time, O(k) extra space. Input: median_sliding_window(nums=[1, 3, -1, -3, 5], k=3). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
bisect.insort(window, nums[i]) — -3 pushed on the front of window

window.pop(bisect.bisect_left(window, nums[i - k])) — 3 popped off the end of window

chapters.title: Two heaps with lazy deletion

frames.caption: Two heaps with lazy deletion — O(n log k) time, O(k) extra space. Input: median_sliding_window(nums=[1, 4, 2, 3], k=4). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
heapq.heappush(large, value) — 2 pushed on the front of large
heapq.heappush(small, -heapq.heappop(large)) — 2 taken from the front of large; -2 pushed on the front of small
value = -heap[0] if heap is small else heap[0] — value = 4
heapq.heappush(large, value) — 3 pushed on the front of large
